text: 此人不能告诉你什么。
source_text: 此人不能告诉你什么。

text: You see a chanter from the Children
source_text: You see a chanter from the Children

text: 你看到了大教堂教徒的吟诵者
source_text: 你看到了大教堂教徒的吟诵者

text: The Master will forgive your sins! Join us and be free! Praise to the Master and his mercy!
source_text: The Master will forgive your sins! Join us and be free! Praise to the Master and his mercy!

text: 主教会赦免你们的罪！加入我们，获得自由吧！赞美主教和他的仁慈！
source_text: 主教会赦免你们的罪！加入我们，获得自由吧！赞美主教和他的仁慈！

text: Hello friend! Will you sing a song of Praise with me? . . . Once I was wandering blind, In a land that was so unkind . . .
source_text: Hello friend! Will you sing a song of Praise with me? . . . Once I was wandering blind, In a land that was so unkind . . .

text: 好啊朋友！你可愿意与我同唱一曲赞歌？……我曾盲目漫游，在这严酷之地上……
source_text: 好啊朋友！你可愿意与我同唱一曲赞歌？……我曾盲目漫游，在这严酷之地上……

text: I hate to interrupt your hymn, but where might I meet the Master?
source_text: I hate to interrupt your hymn, but where might I meet the Master?

text: 我不喜欢打断你们咏唱赞美诗，但是我在哪里能见到主教？
source_text: 我不喜欢打断你们咏唱赞美诗，但是我在哪里能见到主教？

text: Don't quit your day job.
source_text: Don't quit your day job.

text: 别放弃你平日里的专长。
source_text: 别放弃你平日里的专长。

text: Who's in charge here?
source_text: Who's in charge here?

text: 这里谁负责？
source_text: 这里谁负责？

text: . . . but now I kiss the Master's behind . . .
source_text: . . . but now I kiss the Master's behind . . .

text: ……但是现在我在拍主教的马屁……
source_text: ……但是现在我在拍主教的马屁……

text: Happy! Happy! I sing song good!
source_text: Happy! Happy! I sing song good!

text: 高兴！高兴！我的歌唱得真好！
source_text: 高兴！高兴！我的歌唱得真好！

text: He finds you when and where you least expect it! Praise the Master! Praise the Holy Flame! Praise the world!
source_text: He finds you when and where you least expect it! Praise the Master! Praise the Holy Flame! Praise the world!

text: 他在你最无法预料的时间和地点找到了你！赞美主教！赞美圣焰！赞美这世界！
source_text: 他在你最无法预料的时间和地点找到了你！赞美主教！赞美圣焰！赞美这世界！

text: What a wonderful joke! I used to have no sense of humor, but thanks to the Master, I am full of mirth! Praise the Master!
source_text: What a wonderful joke! I used to have no sense of humor, but thanks to the Master, I am full of mirth! Praise the Master!

text: 真是个美妙的笑话！我以前没什么幽默感，但是感谢主教，我现在全身充满欢乐！赞美主教！
source_text: 真是个美妙的笑话！我以前没什么幽默感，但是感谢主教，我现在全身充满欢乐！赞美主教！

text: The one who sits above. The one who sits below. The one who rests within. Praise the Master for such clarity of vision!
source_text: The one who sits above. The one who sits below. The one who rests within. Praise the Master for such clarity of vision!

text: 位居其上者。位居其下者。留居其中者。赞美主教的明察秋毫！
source_text: 位居其上者。位居其下者。留居其中者。赞美主教的明察秋毫！

text: Oh, if only I were so fortunate! Perhaps one day the Master will let me kiss his body parts. Praise the Master! Praise the Holy Flame!
source_text: Oh, if only I were so fortunate! Perhaps one day the Master will let me kiss his body parts. Praise the Master! Praise the Holy Flame!

text: 哦，但愿我真的有那么幸运！或许有一天主教会让我亲吻他的身体部分。赞美主教！赞美圣焰！
source_text: 哦，但愿我真的有那么幸运！或许有一天主教会让我亲吻他的身体部分。赞美主教！赞美圣焰！

text: Hmm, that's not what I had in mind. You had better practice, my friend. Praise to the Master! Praise the Holy Flame!
source_text: Hmm, that's not what I had in mind. You had better practice, my friend. Praise to the Master! Praise the Holy Flame!

text: 呣呣，我心里可没这么想。你最好多练习练习，我的朋友。赞美主教！赞美圣焰！
source_text: 呣呣，我心里可没这么想。你最好多练习练习，我的朋友。赞美主教！赞美圣焰！

text: 【Done】
source_text: 【Done】

text: 【完成】
source_text: 【完成】
